Inference.//UseMock: PoSurvive now auto-loads an in-browser model when the host's cloud relay is unavailable, and TestBudgetGuard sets Inference:UseCloudFallback=false for tests — so without this an E2E-UI test that navigates to /posurvive would pull a few hundred MB from a CDN mid-run. Mock mode makes the provider instant, offline and deterministic, which is what MockInferenceService was always documented to be for. Its scripted per-trait thoughts are also assertable, unlike the fallback table's 'standing by' filler.

Simulation.//: Small, fast and bounded: a UI test should be able to drive a whole match without waiting on a 300-turn ceiling.
